create_model_pose_net: create a pose estimation model from a specified architecture like res, dlav0, dla, resdcn, or hourglass
load_model_checkpoint: load a pretrained model checkpoint into an existing model with optional optimizer resume and learning rate
save_model_checkpoint: save a model and optional optimizer state dict to a file path with the current epoch
create_model_arch_variants: create a detection model using different backbone architectures with configurable heads and head convolution layers
load_model_resume_training: load a model checkpoint and resume training with the optimizer state and adjusted learning rate
